propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor shape (reads raw Jira snapshot keys) while the inbound differ canonicalizes first, creating an asymmetry that blocks epic bbf1 AC3
Core module outbound_differ.py imports vendor-specific helpers from adapters.jira.outbound_fields, violating ADR 0035 §(d) seam principle by forcing core to know Jira snapshot dict structure
The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot via injected InboundMapper, diff in local field names, and emit vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper at emission boundary

InboundMapper output must widen to include canonical aliases: assignee_identity dict (display/email/account_id), remote_parent_id string, and reporter_identity dict, all presence-guarded for partial-baseline tolerance

The assignee resolver and _assignee_is_account_id sentinel contract must re-home to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee parameterized on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving accountId fast-path and unmappable→unassign soft-fail behavior

Decision-for-decision equivalence must hold across full status/priority value maps, assignee shapes, parent changes, ADF description, baseline conflicts, and non-authoritative resolver fallback before vendor helpers are demoted to adapter-internal
